properties.rationale: Standing disposition for planned-but-unbuilt capabilities (user's 2026-07-23 call). The owning component arrives with the build and is not invented ahead of it: claims are new core code and will need their own module, but which module — a new claims.rs, or folded into the provenance layer that already holds Contributor identity — is a real choice about where the seam falls, and guessing it now would put a component in the design that nothing has yet justified. Distinct from the cap:explains-itself case, where allocation was left open because the answer was genuinely ambiguous; here it is simply not yet earned.
